title: Diagram Shape Registry
description: Library-agnostic schema for agent-facing shape registries (v2). UML 2.5 is the first instance; BPMN2, ERD, ArchiMate3, C4, etc. reuse the same structure. CORE fields are library-invariant; the optional METAMODEL block is library-specific and namespaced by its `spec`. v2 adds: render.fingerprint (binds each shape to its palette cell), contains (containment children, distinct from compartment rows), row_types (signatures of legal row children), and a required grammar block pointing at the canonical DSL spec.

library.description: The library/namespace this registry describes (e.g. uml25, bpmn2, erd, archimate3, c4, general).

version.description: Version of the NOTATION the palette implements (e.g. '2.5', '3.2', '2.0'). Use '1' for unversioned notations and 'classic' for legacy palettes.

source_file.description: The draw.io palette fixture this registry was derived from (e.g. UML_2.5.drawio).

pages.description: Palette page names in MENU order. menu_index runs sequentially across pages in this order. Required to join registry entries to the palette data, whose pages may be stored in a different order.

grammar.description: DSL grammar documentation. `spec` points at the canonical language spec; everything else is library-specific notes.

spec.description: Path to the canonical DSL grammar spec, relative to this registry file (e.g. ../GRAMMAR.md).

root.description: The document-root builder function for this library (e.g. UML25, BPMN, C4). Not a palette shape; defined by the grammar spec.

row_types.description: Signatures of the row-child types legal inside this library's shapes (everything referenced by any shape's rows.allowed). Row types are DSL constructs, not palette entries.

passing.description: Calling convention: 'positional' args bind left-to-right from the call's positional arguments (in declaration order); 'keyword_only' args may only be supplied as name=value and are never counted against the positional list. Drives DSL-call argument validation (mdg_drawio.notation._core.dsl_engine).

name.description: Row-type name as used in rows.allowed and in DSL calls (e.g. Item, Header, Lane).

render.description: Binds this registry entry to its palette cell. The fingerprint is a hash of the NORMALIZED style string of the entry's anchor cell (see mdg_drawio.notation._core.normalize); the style strings themselves live in generated data (not committed). Build tooling must fail loudly when a fingerprint no longer matches the palette.

shape.description: A single palette shape. CORE fields are always present; kind-conditional and metamodel sections apply per the rules below.

menu_index.description: Position in the source palette menu, counted sequentially across pages in provenance.pages order. Re-derivable and validated against the source via render.fingerprint.

kind.description: vertex = node (may have rows or contains); edge = connector (has endpoints); diagram = pre-composed fragment (neither).

buildable.description: false for pre-composed fragments an agent should not assemble; it should pick a real primitive instead (see related.see_also).

tag.description: metaclass = the shape IS a metamodel element; notation = a rendering variant of one; composite = a pre-composed fragment; none = pure notation with no metamodel element. Library-invariant concept.

status.description: Provenance of the judgment fields: generated = machine-drafted boilerplate; drafted = substantive machine/LLM draft, not human-verified; reviewed = human/spec-verified. reviewed entries must not contain TODO markers or placeholder text (enforced by tests).

discriminator.description: How this variant differs visibly from its siblings; 'n/a' for single-variant functions.

args.description: Positional/keyword arguments of the DSL call.

rows.description: Nested child-ROW schema for vertices: compartment content that stacks inside the shape (e.g. class members, table rows). Distinct from `contains`.

allowed.description: Legal child row types for this shape (must be defined in row_types).

contains.description: CONTAINMENT schema for container vertices (boundaries, groupings, lanes, frames): child NODES placed inside the container. Mutually exclusive with non-empty rows.allowed. A colon-block under a shape with `contains` nests child nodes; under a shape with non-empty rows it nests rows; a shape with neither cannot take a block.

allowed.description: Legal child node functions, or '*' for any vertex of the same library.

containment.description: Layout hints for how child nodes inside this container are arranged. Only meaningful on shapes that also have `contains`.

strategy.description: How children are laid out: stack (vertical, one per row), grid (balanced ceil(sqrt(n)) columns), freeform (children positioned by the main layout algorithm, container auto-sized around them).

start_size.description: Header/footer offset in pixels before the first child row.

child_gap.description: Gap between child nodes in pixels.

endpoints.description: Universal (library-invariant) connector endpoints for edges. Spec-typed source/target live under metamodel.endpoints.

example.description: A copy-pasteable DSL call with placeholder ids, namespaced as <library>.<Function>(...).

allOf.description: kind-conditional: vertices have rows, edges have endpoints, diagrams have neither.
rows/contains exclusivity: a container shape must not also declare row children.
metamodel-conditional: tag:none forbids the metamodel block; any other tag requires it.

metamodel.description: Library-specific extension. Namespaced by `spec` so BPMN2/ERD/ArchiMate3/C4 reuse the same slot with their own vocabularies. Structure is validated; element/is_a VALUES are not (left to generation scripts, or an optional per-spec vocabulary schema).

spec.description: Which metamodel this block conforms to. Extend this enum as libraries are added.

element.description: The metamodel element/metaclass name this shape represents.

is_a.description: Generalization/inheritance chain from the metamodel (most specific first).

endpoints.description: Spec-typed connector endpoints (edges only). Source/target are metamodel element names.

classification.description: Optional spec-specific taxonomy dimensions (e.g. ArchiMate layer/aspect, BPMN element group, C4 external flag). Keys vary by spec; values are strings or null. This is the sanctioned place for library-specific categorization without loosening the core metamodel fields.
